You just pay for however long you take so say you take one month to complete the entire course you'll just end up paying $50. While if you take 12 months to complete the entire course you'll pay $600 so it's just a matter of how long you take to complete the course and that's how much you aren't going to pay. So in this course, there's five different modules. The first one is about technical support fundamentals where you just learn how to troubleshoot things, customer service and things like that. The second one is going to be about networking. The third is operating systems. The fourth is going to be system administration and infrastructure services. And the last one is it security. so in each of those five modules there are gonna be five to six different sections called weeks and within each of these weeks there are going to be about five to ten different short videos which range from around one minute to around 15 minutes so there's gonna be a bunch of short videos and also towards the end of each section each week you're going to be having a practice quiz the relatively short as well the only like five to ten questions max and also depending on which module you guys are on you guys also face a practice lab which is also graded so the practice labs don't really take a long time to finish. The labs come with, you know, descriptive instructions that you guys can just follow along with it. And you guys also learn a lot from these labs so make sure to not just zoom through it but also take the time to understand the concepts and what it's trying to teach you. And that goes for the whole course. So for the content itself, the short videos, they're not really boring. You guys are going to have someone like this speaking to you directly in the videos. You guys can toggle subtitles to make it easier to read and understand and also under the videos you guys are going to have the script that the narrator is going to be reading from so you guys can just scroll down instead of looking at their face the whole time like this. You guys might get bored of that so if you can just scroll it down and you guys can just follow along as they're reading to you. So these videos are not boring at all they're pretty easy to follow along and you guys can take notes while you are listening to the videos and you guys can pause and do everything like that so what do I think of this course well since I was a complete beginner I had no previous IT background this course was really helpful for me now like I said before guys this course covers five different aspects of it. You guys can just hop in and take another Compitea course or another certificate or something like that. This course is just about getting the fundamentals down and, you know, different aspects of IT. It's not really necessary. This course might help you decide which CompTIA certification you guys want to do next, or even which IT branch you guys want to hop into. security, networking, or anything like that. The speaker also qualifies the course's employment relevance by noting that he had not yet received callbacks, rather than making a guaranteed career or income promise.
